title: Nu Skin Enterprises to Present at ICR Conference
summary: Discover the best you, inside and out, with our integrated beauty and wellness products.
body_text: Nu Skin Enterprises to Discuss Company Strategy and Opportunities at ICR Conference PROVO, Utah — Jan. 9, 2026 — Nu Skin Enterprises Inc. (NYSE: NUS) today announced president and CEO Ryan Napierski will participate in a moderated fireside chat to discuss company strategy and the state of the business on Monday, Jan. 12. The discussion will include the company’s plans in 2026 for launching its Prysm iO intelligent wellness device and future opportunities in emerging markets, including India. The company's fireside chat will be webcast live beginning at 1:30 p.m. ET. Those wishing to access the event can visit the Nu Skin investor relations page at ir.nuskin.com. The archive of the webcast will be available at this same location through Monday, Jan. 26. About Nu Skin Enterprises Inc. The Nu Skin Enterprises Inc. (NYSE: NUS) family of companies includes Nu Skin and Rhyz Inc. Nu Skin is an integrated beauty and wellness company, powered by a dynamic affiliate opportunity platform, which operates in nearly 50 markets worldwide. Backed by 40 years of scientific research, the company’s products help people look, feel and live their best with brands including Nu Skin® personal care, Pharmanex® nutrition and ageLOC® anti-aging, which includes an award-winning line of beauty device systems. Formed in 2018, Rhyz is a synergistic ecosystem of consumer, technology and manufacturing companies focused on innovation within the beauty, wellness and lifestyle categories. # # #

title: Master Expense Tracking: Simple Steps to Manage Your Money
summary: Unlock the secrets to effective money management with our comprehensive guide on expense tracking. Discover practical methods for monitoring your spending, avoiding overspending, and achieving your financial goals.
body_text: Wondering how to stay on top of your finances? Expense tracking lets you monitor your income and expenses, providing a clear picture of where your money goes. In this article, you’ll learn about some simple steps to master financial tracking and achieve your financial goals. Key Takeaways Financial tracking is crucial for identifying spending patterns and optimizing expenses, ultimately leading to smarter financial decisions. There are two methods for financial tracking - manual tracking, which can make you more aware of healthy and unhealthy spending patterns, and automated tracking, which reduces the time and energy it takes to stay on top of your finances. It’s important to build a habit of categorizing expenses, setting financial goals, and periodically adjusting spending habits to align with where you want to be financially What is Expense Tracking? Expense tracking is like having a financial health monitor, continuously keeping an eye on the lifeline of your finances: income and expenses. Think of it as a compass guiding you through the wilderness of the financial world, helping you to navigate towards your goals. Why is expense tracking a game-changer? It shines a light on spending patterns, allowing you to cut back on the unnecessary so that you can focus on the necessary. More importantly, it lays the groundwork for developing an actionable plan to achieve your future financial dreams, transforming abstract ambitions into tangible targets. Why Expense Tracking Matters Have you ever wondered where your paycheck disappears each month? Expense tracking is the detective work that solves this mystery. By closely monitoring your spending habits, you can identify areas of overspending, which paves the way for smarter budget adjustments. It’s not just about cutting corners; it’s about making your money work harder and smarter for you. The beauty of financial tracking lies in its power to save you money, identify financial red flags early on, and empower you to make informed decisions that resonate with your long-term visions. This practice gives you a clear snapshot of your financial landscape, guaranteeing effective utilization of your hard-earned money. Embracing this practice means taking the reins of your financial journey and steering it towards success, one tracked transaction at a time. Methods to Track Your Finances Every financial move, from the receipt of your income to the payment of monthly bills, can be tracked. But how? There are several paths one can take, from the traditional to the technological, each with its own set of tools and techniques. Whether you prefer the tactile feel of pen on paper or the swift tap on a smartphone screen, tracking your finances is about choosing the method that resonates with your lifestyle. Manual Tracking Manually writing your transactions in a notebook or digitally in a spreadsheet brings a heightened level of awareness to your spending habits. It’s about taking control, being accountable, and making each dollar count. Although we live in an automated, AI-filled world, there are still benefits to doing this by hand, especially when you are just starting out. Knowing that you have to write the amount of a transaction in a spreadsheet might make you think twice about an unplanned expense. One popular way of tracking your expenses is the envelope method. With the envelope method, you take all of your cash for a period (for example, a month) and distribute your income into separate envelopes, each for a specific category of spending. Examples are rent, groceries, gas, and self care. Any time you make a purchase, you take the cash out of the envelope and write down what it was for. Once all of the cash from an envelope is gone, that’s it! No more spending until the envelope is replenished again. It requires discipline, but it also fosters a deeper connection with your finances, turning the act of expense tracking into a mindful routine. In this context, exploring ways to track expenses can be both practical and engaging. Automated Tracking On the other hand, automated tracking uses technology to streamline your financial management. Budgeting apps like You Need a Budget or financial tools like Finta securely connect directly to your bank account, categorizing your transactions, tracking expenses, and providing actionable insights without the need to input data manually. These apps are designed to build momentum in your budgeting habit, doing the heavy lifting so you can focus on the bigger financial picture. Using a budgeting tool gives you more than just tracking abilities; it provides a comprehensive overview of your finances. With all your financial information in one place, you can easily manage monthly bills, save money for an emergency fund, and keep track of your cash flow. Automated tracking is about efficiency and integration, ensuring that every transaction is accounted for and every financial decision is made with complete awareness. Best Tools for Financial Tracking Despite the merits of manual tracking, it can become monotonous over time. That’s where financial tracking tools step in, offering a range of features to keep your finances in check without the hassle. Some benefits of using financial tracking tools include: Automatic syncing of your account balances Categorizing your spending patterns Generating reports and visualizations of your financial data Reminders for bill payments and upcoming expenses These tools are your allies in the quest for financial clarity. Finta Instead of having to download and manage an entirely new app, Finta automatically syncs your account balances and transactions into tools that you already use. Finta integrates with Airtable, Notion, Coda, and Google Sheets to make it easy to security, efficiently and seamlessly track your spending. This means you can say goodbye to the daily chore of typing in your spending. Finta also uses AI to auto-categorize your transactions and has a Rules Engine which lets you set your own custom categorization rules. Finta isn’t just about tracking your expenses; it’s about creating a financial ecosystem that works for you where you need it the most. Starting at $7 a month or $70 a year, it's one of the most affordable ways to automate your finances. Mint Mint used to be a popular choice for those seeking a comprehensive financial overview. It could sync with bank accounts, categorize spending, and provide insights into your net worth, making it a valuable asset in the financial tracking toolkit. However, Mint has ceased operations in 2024, serving as a reminder that the financial tools landscape is ever-changing. Though we can no longer recommend Mint, its legacy endures as a benchmark for what a good budgeting app should offer. The ability to manage everything from mortgage payments to groceries is a standard we now expect from financial apps. Mint’s shutdown underscores the importance of choosing a system or a tool that doesn't lock you in and gives you flexibility to take your data with you. Building a Budget Based on Your Personal Finances Once your spending patterns are revealed through financial tracking, you can construct a budget that is in line with your actual financial situation and goals. The process involves categorizing expenses, setting financial objectives, and shaping your spending habits to create a budget that’s not just numbers on a spreadsheet, but a roadmap to financial freedom. Categorizing Expenses Categorizing expenses is the cornerstone of budgeting. It provides clarity on where your money is going and identifies areas ripe for adjustment. By distinguishing between needs and wants, you can prioritize essential living and working expenses, while non-essentials like dining out or entertainment can be kept in check. The 50/30/20 budget rule is a helpful framework, advocating for 50% of your income to go towards needs, 30% towards wants, and 20% towards savings and debt repayment. This categorization is not just about tracking spending patterns; it’s about making informed decisions that can lead to a more balanced financial life. As you sort your expenses, you might find that certain costs can be dialed back, freeing up more resources for your savings or debt repayment. It’s a strategic approach that can evolve as your financial situation changes, ensuring your budget remains a true reflection of your economic priorities. Setting Financial Goals Financial goals serve as a guiding beacon on your financial journey. By setting clear objectives, you can focus your tracking and budgeting efforts towards achieving specific milestones. Monitoring progress towards these goals can be incredibly motivating, providing a tangible sense of accomplishment as you move closer to your aspirations. It’s not just about setting goals; it’s about staying true to them. Financial tracking holds you accountable, ensuring that you remain committed to the financial targets you’ve set for yourself. Whether it’s building an emergency fund or paying off high-interest debt, defining your financial priorities helps you to direct your resources where they’re needed most. Adjusting Spending Habits It’s essential to periodically revisit and adjust your budget once it’s established, to accommodate any changes in your financial situation. This is where adjusting spending habits comes into play. By targeting big fixed costs like housing, vehicles, and utilities, you can potentially lower your monthly expenses and find additional ways to save. Periodic reviews of your fixed expenses can reveal opportunities for savings, such as finding more affordable car insurance or renegotiating your cell phone plan. Financial tracking shines a light on these possibilities, granting you the flexibility to adapt to unexpected expenses or income changes, ensuring that you’re always on the most efficient path toward your financial goals. Tips for Effective Expense Tracking Mastering the art of expense tracking isn’t just about recording numbers; it’s about adopting money habits and practices that ensure the accuracy and usefulness of the information you collect. Here are some financial tips to help you stay on top of your financial game. Regularly Review Transactions Regularly reviewing your transactions not only helps to maintain an accurate financial record but also enables you to spot and address potential issues promptly. This routine check-up can provide valuable insights into your spending habits, distinguishing between fixed and variable expenses, and helping you track expenses effectively. By setting aside time each month to go through your finances, you ensure that your budget reflects your current financial situation and goals. It’s like giving your finances a monthly health check, catching any discrepancies early on and reaffirming your commitment to your financial well-being. Use Alerts and Reminders Just like many other areas, financial tracking also benefits from the countless tools offered by the modern world to help us stay organized. Utilizing alerts and reminders for upcoming bill payments or low account balances can prevent overdraft fees and keep your budget on track,. If you’ve created a custom financial dashboard, automations can be your best friend, reminding you of bills or warning you when your funds are running low. Budgeting apps are particularly adept at providing timely notifications, ensuring you never miss a payment or overspend your budget. These reminders act as a safety net, allowing you to focus on the bigger picture without sweating the small stuff. It’s about using technology to access a hassle-free financial experience. Keep Personal and Business Finances Separate If you’re managing both personal and business finances, maintaining their separation is essential for accurate financial tracking and reporting. Dedicated accounts for personal and business expenses not only simplify the tracking process but also provide a clear visual representation of where your funds are allocated. Also, having separate accounts ensures that tax preparation is as easy and accurate as possible. Summary Embarking on a journey to master expense tracking might have seemed daunting at first, but as we’ve explored the various tools, methods, and tips, it’s clear that managing your money can be both straightforward and rewarding. By taking the time to understand and implement these simple tips, you’ve equipped yourself with the knowledge and skills to take control of your financial destiny. Frequently Asked Questions What's the benefit of using a budgeting tool over manual tracking? Using a budgeting tool over manual tracking saves time and offers convenience by automating the expense tracking process and providing a comprehensive overview of your finances. This helps you track expenses and manage your money more efficiently without the need for manual entry. If you're looking for a tool to make expense tracking more seamless, try out Finta today! How often should I revisit my budget? You should revisit your budget at least every month or whenever a significant change occurs in your financial situation. This will help ensure that your budget aligns with your current income, expenses, and financial goals, allowing you to make necessary adjustments. Why is it important to keep personal and business finances separate? It is important to keep personal and business finances separate because it simplifies tracking, ensures accurate financial reporting, makes tax preparation easier, and provides a clearer picture of both personal and business financial health. It ultimately helps to avoid confusion and maintain financial clarity. Should I budget every penny? This greatly depends on the person. When you're first starting out, it might be helpful to be as exact as possible, especially if you have a large savings goal or debt paydown goal. However, as you get the hang of expense tracking, you might be able to loosen up a bit without completely derailing your budget.

title: Federal Funding Should Support Communities, Not Political Agendas
summary: Congressional investments should reach the communities they were intended to serve.
body_text: Back to News & Commentary Federal Funding Should Support Communities, Not Political Agendas Congressional investments should reach the communities they were intended to serve. Linda Morris , ACLU Women's Rights Project Amanda Walgrove Share This Page July 20, 2026 Congressional investments should reach the communities they were intended to serve. Researcher Katie Edwards has dedicated her career to reducing violence among LGBTQ+ and Indigenous youth , building programs that help young people feel safe and supported. Josefina Navar, deputy director of HOPE Fair Housing (HOPE), works to help families across Illinois access safe and stable housing . Adam Odsess-Rubin helped found the National Queer Theater to amplify the voices of LGBTQ+ artists facing censorship abroad. These organizations , and countless others throughout the country, could soon risk losing the funding they need to deliver critical resources that millions of Americans rely on. On May 29, 2026, the U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and 40+ agencies proposed sweeping changes to overhaul the set of rules governing federal grants to nonprofits, state and local governments, and other grantees. If implemented, this proposal will unlawfully reshape how federal funding is awarded and administered, putting essential services at risk. “Families could lose access to early childhood education programs,” said Linda Morris, senior staff attorney in the ACLU Women’s Rights Project, “survivors of abuse could face greater barriers to support, researchers could lose funding for lifesaving scientific work, and health care providers could face new obstacles to delivering care.” Weaponizing Federal Grants for Trump's Political Agenda The proposed rule would give the Trump administration sweeping authority to approve, deny, or cut off funding to organizations based on the government’s political agenda, not community needs. This blatant power grab undermines longstanding civil rights protections and threatens to suppress viewpoints the government disagrees with by leveraging financial resources. In fact, the rule would impose unlawful restrictions on funding related to transgender people, gender-affirming care, addressing racial health disparities and reproductive health. It would also impose unlawful bans on diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility and so-called “gender ideology” that undermine civil rights and civil liberties.Individuals who rely on federally funded programs will be penalized for their views or their identity. It’s clear that this is a rule designed to lock up taxpayer funds that previously went to programs that supported all Americans and redistribute those funds to programs that politically align with the current administration’s priorities. Putting Vulnerable Communities and Critical Services at Risk If the proposed rule goes into effect, every single American could feel the impact of these haphazard funding bans. Children won’t receive high-quality education that Head Start previously would have been able to provide in their first language, survivors of domestic violence will face increased barriers in receiving essential shelter and services, Americans’ access to HIV treatment will be limited, and gender-affirming care will be harder to receive. The ripple effect will be undeniable. Any organization that receives federal funding will be faced with unnecessary red tape, added costs, and administrative burdens — adding significant financial risks that many may not be able to overcome. Essential services will be disrupted. Scientific research will be altered or halted. And viewpoints that don’t match the administration’s agenda will be suppressed. Disruptions to essential federal programs worsen inequality and have an outsized impact on households of color, immigrant families, people with disabilities, and LGBTQ+ individuals, who receive a disproportionate amount of the affected services and programs due to the ongoing systemic inequality and discrimination they face. Protecting Programs That Serve the Public The ACLU proudly represents many clients who would be negatively impacted by this proposed rule, including nonprofit organizations serving transgender and gender nonconforming people, researchers and scientists, community health centers, artists and arts organizations, educational programs, and other recipients of federal funding. We urge OMB and all participating federal agencies to withdraw the proposed rule in its entirety and preserve a federal grants system that is transparent, lawful, and focused on serving the public rather than advancing a political agenda. LOUIS — The American Civil Liberties Union and the ACLU of North Dakota filed an amicus brief today with the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit in Thunderhawk v. Kirchmeier, a case that challenges the government’s decision to close a public road during a Standing Rock protest, preventing people from assembling to express their opposition to the Dakota Access Pipeline. In the brief, the ACLU argues that roads of every kind — including rural roads, multi-lane roads and high-speed roads — have served as sites of protest throughout United States history, from the civil rights marches and anti-war demonstrations of the 1960s and ’70s to more recent protests, including marches in opposition to abortion, in support of rural healthcare and against police brutality. Courts across the country have long recognized that roads are quintessential traditional public forums and open for public assembly, debate, and the communication of ideas. “The government’s argument disregards our history of protest in the United States and misinterprets our fundamental First Amendment rights. Our right to assemble and protest in the streets should never depend on the type of roadway chosen,” said Andrew Malone, senior staff attorney for the ACLU of North Dakota. “The Supreme Court has repeatedly affirmed that protesting in public streets is a time-honored American right. It is long overdue for police officers, prosecutors and government officials to uphold this constitutional standard.” For nearly eight years and through multiple rounds of dismissals and appeals, the government has argued that some streets, including rural roads, don’t belong to the community and that the road at issue in this case doesn’t deserve the same protection afforded to other public spaces. But, the ACLU argues in the brief, as one of the few communal spaces in rural areas, these roads are uniquely positioned to offer rural communities – and those wishing to address them – a public space in which to associate, communicate thoughts and discuss public issues. “Protesting on public roads is as American as apple pie, and that doesn’t change whether the road is a rural highway in North Dakota or 42nd St in New York City,” said Vera Eidelman, senior staff attorney with the ACLU’s Speech, Privacy, and Technology Project. “People can turn the page in a magazine or change the channel on TV, but streets remain one of the few places where we have to confront ideas we might otherwise tune out—and that’s why our rights to protest on streets, sidewalks, and in public parks are so important.” Court Case: Thunderhawk v. Press Release Jun 2026 Racial Justice Civil Liberties ACLU Reacts to Draft Bipartisan AI Bill That Would Preempt State Laws WASHINGTON — Today, Congressman Obernolte and Congresswoman Trahan released a draft regulatory framework for Artificial Intelligence, which they may soon introduce in the House of Representatives. This draft bill – if enacted into law – would largely prohibit states from regulating AI developers. It would block states from enforcing existing state protections and from enacting new protections This could include anything from privacy regulations to antidiscrimination requirements to AI safety laws. Congress has twice overwhelmingly rejected legislative proposals to block states from regulating AI, also known as “preemption.” This includes a 99-1 Senate vote last year against an amendment that would have created a 10-year moratorium on state AI regulation. Seventeen Republican governors joined the bipartisan opposition to that failed amendment. In response, Jina John, senior policy counsel for AI, privacy and technology at the ACLU released the following statement: "This draft bill fails to learn from Congress’s previous attempts to block state AI regulations. States must be able to protect their own residents from harm, hold tech companies accountable, and ensure that AI is safe and trustworthy. "Governors, attorneys general, and lawmakers from both parties have opposed the efforts to push states aside for good reason. AI touches all aspects of people’s lives in this country, including employment, healthcare, lending, education, and so much more. So far, it has been governors and state legislatures—and largely not Congress or the president—who have been trying to protect the American people from harms that AI may cause. The federal government must not grant tech giants a blank check to deploy these technologies without the oversight of states." Aclu Reacts To Draft Bipartisan Ai Bill That Would Preempt State Laws. title: Array Labs Awarded Air Force Contract to Demonstrate Formation Flight Technology
summary: Array Labs has won an AFWERX contract to further develop and fly a custom protective coating for space vehicles. Launching in the first half of this year, Array's first mission will demonstrate the coating's applications for advanced formation flight.
body_text: PALO ALTO, Jan. 18, 2024 – Array Labs, the leading 3D imaging company, today announced its recent contract win with AFWERX, a program of the Air Force Research Lab (AFRL). The contract supports Array’s development of specialized satellite coatings that have demonstrated protective qualities and the potential to reduce conventional propulsion requirements on orbit. Array Labs is pioneering the use of dozens of distributed, cooperative radar cubesats, flying in precise formation to create a giant synthetic antenna aperture for high-resolution, high-revisit 3D mapping of Earth. The AFWERX award enables further R&D and marks a significant step in Array's development of advanced formation flight and resilient space technologies. Leveraging unique material science innovations, Array Labs has developed a coating that could provide resistance to a perennial atmospheric challenge faced by space vehicles – atomic oxygen erosion. The coating has been put through its paces at a state-of-the-art aerospace environmental testing facility, with the space weathering experiments yielding highly promising results. The coating could extend the useful life of space systems in low Earth orbit (LEO). In addition, the material is being evaluated as a method for satellites to maneuver more efficiently and cost-effectively, by generating lift, which would substantially reduce on-orbit propulsion requirements for many LEO smallsat missions. This technology not only stands to support Array’s formation-flying satellite clusters, it also aligns with the Pentagon’s call for more resilient space capabilities. “A first-of-its-kind commercial constellation demands first-principles thinking. Our latest coating shows how we put this philosophy into practice, and provides a sneak peek into the new capabilities we’re assembling for our satellite clusters,” Andrew Peterson, CEO and Chief Engineer at Array Labs, stated. “Partnering with the United States Air Force is a pivotal step in our journey," Peterson said. "We’re thrilled to have their support as we prepare to launch our first mission, study the coating’s performance in space, and continue executing towards Array Labs’ first formation flight.” Over the course of the contract, which is already underway, Array Labs will refine the coating, conduct further ground tests, and finalize plans to demonstrate the technology on orbit in the first half of 2024. Note: The views expressed are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the official policy or position of the Department of the Air Force, the Department of Defense, or the U.S. government.

title: TikTok and iHeartPodcasts Welcome Hit Show “Raiders of the Lost Podcast” to the TikTok Podcast Network
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_text: Hosted by filmmaker brothers James and Anthony Deveney, the top-ranked Film and TV podcast continues with three new episodes each week Listen to “Raiders of the Lost Podcast” now, HERE NEW YORK – July 13, 2026 – iHeartPodcasts, the No. 1 podcast publisher globally according to Podtrac , and TikTok today announced the hit film and television podcast series “Raiders of the Lost Podcast,” hosted by identical twin brothers, filmmakers and self-proclaimed film geeks James and Anthony Deveney, has joined the recently announced TikTok Podcast Network . Beginning today, listeners can check out “Raiders of the Lost Podcast” HERE . The popular podcast has become a go-to destination for movie and television fans for its passionate deep dives, reviews and analysis of both new releases and classic favorites. The show regularly features conversations with actors, filmmakers and industry professionals, giving audiences a behind-the-scenes look at the creative forces shaping today's biggest films and television series. TikTok and iHeartMedia continue to build new opportunities for creators to extend their voices across audio, video and live experiences, while giving fans even more ways to connect with the cultural moments shaping today’s conversations. The TikTok Podcast Network features TikTok’s biggest content creators driving what’s next in popular culture and giving audiences more ways to discover and engage with the content they love. “We started this podcast because we could talk about movies and television for hours anyway, so we figured we might as well turn on some microphones,” said James and Anthony Deveney. “What began as two brothers obsessing over films has grown into a huge community of fellow movie fans. We're thrilled to join iHeart and the TikTok Podcast Network and can't wait to bring even more reviews, deep dives and conversations to listeners everywhere.” "TikTok has become a destination where entertainment fandom comes to life, and the TikTok Podcast Network gives creators a new way to deepen those conversations beyond the platform. Raiders of the Lost Podcast is built for passionate movie fans, and we're excited to welcome James and Anthony to the network,” said Dan Page, Global Head of Global Media and Licensing Partnerships at TikTok. “James and Anthony have taken a lifelong love of movies and turned it into one of the most popular film-focused podcasts in the world,” said Will Pearson, President of iHeartPodcasts. “Their passion, knowledge and genuine love of storytelling have resonated with audiences everywhere. We're excited to welcome ‘Raiders of the Lost Podcast’ to the network and give fans even more ways to discover and connect.” Launched in March 2026 , the TikTok Podcast Network is a first-of-its-kind partnership between TikTok and iHeartMedia that brings some of the platform’s most influential creators into long-form podcasting. Designed to expand creator storytelling beyond short-form video, the network combines TikTok’s creator ecosystem with iHeartMedia’s industry-leading podcast production, distribution and monetization capabilities. GEICO serves as the network’s exclusive launch partner, creating new opportunities for brands to engage audiences through creator-led podcast content. The slate also includes “ The Set List with Carter Gregory ” hosted by media personality, music executive and cultural tastemaker Carter Gregory (@ thecarterb ); “ Sports Slice ”” hosted by sports influencer Tim Martin (@ timbosliceoflife12 ); “ The Clifford Show ” hosted by former college football player turned viral sports creator Clifford Taylor IV (@ clifford ); “ Suite 305 with Lele Pons ” hosted by multihyphenate and social media star Lele Pons (@ lelepons ); and coming soon “Caroline’s Closet” hosted by fashion editor, author and personality Caroline Vazzana (@ cvazzana ). All podcasts on the TikTok Podcast Network are distributed by iHeartPodcasts. “Raiders of the Lost Podcast” is available on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard. New episodes drop three times per week on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Clips, highlights and behind-the-scenes moments from the show will also be featured across TikTok .
